items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美7月非農爆冷 金價本周大漲逾7%創1月來最佳單周
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: US July Nonfarm Payrolls Surprise Cold, Gold Prices Surge Over 7% This Week, Best Single Week Since January
paras: 現貨金價周五 (7 日) 大漲，登上七周高點，主因是美國當天公布的 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，抑制了聯準會 (Fed) 立即升息的可能性，並幫助金價一周漲幅擴大到 7% 以上，交出七個月來最佳單周表現。

黃金現貨跳漲 2.3%，報每盎司 4336.02 美元，盤中稍早觸及 6 月 17 日以來最高。
12 月交割的黃金期貨收高 2.3%，報每盎司 4399.70 美元。
黃金本周大漲逾 7%，創 1 月 19 日以來最大漲幅。


美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，經濟學家原估會增加 8 萬人。6 月增幅也下修至 2 萬人。
High Ridge Futures 金屬交易主管 David Meger 說：「遜於預期的就業數據讓市場出現一種情境，也就是 Fed 下次會議升息的可能性降低。」他指出，能源價格下跌，加上美國升息可能性降低，預示美元可能走弱，金價則可能走強。
根據 LSEG 數據，利率期貨市場目前反映 Fed 9 月升息的機率為 43.9%，低於就業報告公布前的 57%。Fed 下月維持利率不變的機率則升至 56.1%，高於數據公布前的 43.2%。
由於黃金本身不孳息，較低的利率將提高黃金相對於具收益資產的吸引力。
瑞銀 (UBS) 周五預測，金價將在 2027 年上半年升至每盎司 5000 美元。
地緣政治方面，美國總統川普周四告訴記者，他認為伊朗戰爭「很快」就會結束。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀上漲 3%，報每盎司 63.29 美元。
現貨白金上漲 1.1%，報每盎司 1747.60 美元。
現貨鈀金上漲 0.8%，報每盎司 1381.61 美元。
這三種金屬本周周線同步收高。
paras_en: Spot gold jumped big Friday (7th), hitting a seven‑week high, because US July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell, dampening odds of an immediate Fed rate hike and helping gold’s weekly gain expand to over 7%, the best single‑week performance in seven months.

Spot gold surged 2.3% to $4,336.02 per ounce, briefly touching its highest level since June 17 earlier in the session. December‑delivery gold futures rose 2.3% to $4,399.70 per ounce. Gold has rallied more than 7% this week, the biggest rise since Jan 19. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported on Friday that July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly declined by 23,000 jobs, versus economists’ estimate of an 80,000‑job increase. The June gain was also revised down to 20,000.

David Meger, metals trading head at High Ridge Futures, said: “The weaker‑than‑expected jobs data created a scenario where the probability of a Fed rate hike at the next meeting is reduced.” He added that falling energy prices and a lower likelihood of U.S. rate hikes point to a weaker dollar and stronger gold.

LSEG data show the futures market now assigns a 43.9% probability to a Fed rate hike in September, down from 57% before the jobs report. The odds of the Fed holding rates steady next month have risen to 56.1%, up from 43.2% pre‑data.
Because gold yields no interest, lower rates increase its appeal relative to income‑producing assets.
UBS forecast on Friday that gold could reach $5,000 per ounce in the first half of 2027.
On the geopolitical front, U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters on Thursday that he believes the war with Iran will end “very soon.”

Other precious‑metal prices: spot silver up 3% at $63.29 per ounce; spot platinum up 1.1% at $1,747.60 per ounce; spot palladium up 0.8% at $1,381.61 per ounce. All three metals closed higher on the weekly chart.

items.title: 美Fed獨立性再受挑戰 川普再提房貸爭議 重啟撤換庫克程序
paras: 美國總統川普政府本週表示，正「考慮」再度撤換聯準會 (Fed) 理事庫克(Lisa Cook)，並以房貸申報爭議為由要求其提出說明，顯示白宮與美國央行之間的緊張關係再度升溫。
白宮總統助理史卡維諾 (Dan Scavino) 於週三致函庫克，指稱「有充分理由相信你在一項或多項房貸申請中作出不實陳述」，並要求庫克在三週內提供「解釋與相關證據」。白宮表示，此舉是依據美國最高法院 6 月裁定後的法律框架進行。
該爭議最早源於川普去年首次試圖撤換庫克時提出的指控，內容涉及其房貸申報可能存在不實陳述。庫克當時否認所有指控，並提起訴訟挑戰解職決定。
聯邦法院在訴訟審理期間裁定暫停川普的撤換行動，而最高法院於 6 月以 5 比 4 的裁決維持該暫停令，但首席大法官羅伯茲 (John Roberts) 同時指出，該裁定並未阻止總統在提出新事證後再次嘗試撤換，只是必須遵守正當程序。
史卡維諾在信中表示，此次行動「依據最高法院意見」展開，並要求庫克就相關指控提出說明。
庫克的律師洛威爾 (Abbe Lowell) 則回應指出，相關指控「與一年前一樣毫無根據」，並批評川普試圖干預聯準會獨立性。他表示，「無論川普接下來採取何種行動，根據事實與最高法院判例，都不存在撤換庫克的正當理由」，並強調將再次提出法律挑戰以維護其職位與聯準會制度完整性。
聯準會方面則拒絕對白宮來函置評。
庫克為前總統拜登任命的理事。川普首次試圖撤換她的背景，正值其持續向聯準會施壓要求降息之際，顯示貨幣政策與政治角力之間的緊張關係。
此次房貸爭議最初由美國聯邦住房金融局 (FHFA) 局長比爾 · 普爾特 (Bill Pulte) 提出。普爾特被外界形容為川普的「政治攻擊手」，近年亦曾針對其他政治人物提出類似房貸相關指控，包括紐約州檢察長詹姆斯(Letitia James)。
該事件使聯準會人事再度成為政治焦點。市場人士指出，若白宮持續推進撤換程序，可能進一步引發外界對聯準會政策獨立性的疑慮，並加劇金融市場對利率政策不確定性的評估。
目前白宮尚未明確表示是否將正式啟動第二次撤換程序，但已要求庫克在三週內回應指控，意味相關政治與法律攻防仍將持續延燒。
整體而言，此次事件不僅涉及個別理事去留，更反映美國行政部門與央行之間在貨幣政策與制度獨立性上的長期張力，後續發展將牽動市場對美國金融治理穩定性的信心。

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉非農爆冷Fed、升息機率陡降！標普登新高 單周大漲3.6%今年來次佳
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Slash Fed Rate‑Hike Odds; S&P Hits New High, Weekly Gain 3.6% Best Since April
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，降低聯準會 (Fed)9 月升息的必要性，美股周五(7 日) 上漲，標普 500 指數創新高，並以單周上漲 3.6% 寫下 4 月以來最佳表現，也是今年來第二大單周漲幅。
標普本周稍早才首度登上 7700 點，本周累計上漲 3.6%。那斯達克在晶片股帶動下，本周上漲 5.2%，道瓊一周上漲將近 3%。這三大指數都創下 4 月以來最佳單周。
美國周五公布 7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，遠不及市場所估的增加 8.3 萬人。失業率降到 4.1%，低於經濟學家預測的 4.2%，勞動參與率降至超過五年來最低水準。
芝商所 (CME)FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員如今普遍預測，Fed 9 月很可能按兵不動，把利率維持在 3.50-3.75% 區間。相形之下，交易員一天前還認為 9 月會有 55% 的機率升息。
美國總統川普周五接受 Punchbowl News 訪問時，再度重申偏好較低利率。
與此同時，油價小幅走高，投資人等待美國與伊朗可能達成協議、重新開放荷姆茲海峽。美國財長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早曾表示，雙方可能很快達成協議。
目前伊朗政府據報正就與阿曼針對荷姆茲海峽提出的協議斟酌文字內容，川普則堅稱協議正逐步接近。

美股周五 (7 日) 主要指數表現： 


道瓊工業指數上漲 151.83 點，或 0.28%，收 54,063.93 點。
那斯達克綜合指數上漲 342.26 點，或 1.30%，收 26,690.62 點。
標普 500 指數上漲 47.68 點，或 0.62%，收 7,757.64 點。 
費城半導體指數上漲 308.09 點，或 2.56%，收 12,356.79 點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲 301.95 點，或 1.64%，收 18,723.04 點。


標普 11 大類股中有 8 個上漲，以基本金屬和工業類股漲最多，能源、通訊服務和金融則下跌。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG + 指數中的科技五大巨頭多上揚。Meta(META-US)上漲 0.37%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 0.29%；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)下跌 0.96%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 微漲 0.03%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 0.82%。
費半成分股多走高。Microchip(MCHP-US)大漲近 14%，Coherent(COHR-US)勁揚逾 13%，高通 (QCOM-US) 漲 4.66%，輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.3%。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.44%，超微 (AMD-US) 跌 1.21%。
台股 ADR 跌漲互見。台積電 ADR(TSM-US) 上漲 0.44%；日月光 ADR(ASX-US) 上漲 0.38%；聯電 ADR(UMC-US) 下跌 2.50%；中華電信 ADR(CHT-US) 上漲 0.57%。

企業新聞

軟體股周五領漲美股，最新一輪財報消除了人工智慧 (AI) 將顛覆軟體產業的疑慮：雲端資安公司 Cloudflare(NET-US)公布強勁的全年及當季展望後，股價大漲 5.8%；Atlassian(TEAM-US)第 4 季調整後獲利與營收均優於預期，並給出樂觀財測，股價飆升 35%。
Microchip Technology(MCHP-US) 公布的第 2 季財測優於市場預期，股價大漲 13.9%。
Airbnb(ABNB-US) 股價大漲 17.4%，這家度假租賃平台第 2 季營收與獲利均優於市場預期，並以美國及歐洲需求強勁為由，上調全年營收預測。
美國太陽能股走高，主因是川普下令對多晶矽衍生產品進口課徵 15% 關稅並設定最低進口價格，範圍涵蓋矽晶圓、太陽能電池及太陽能模組。第一太陽能 (First Solar)(FSLR-US) 上揚 2.4%。

華爾街分析

針對非農就業人口爆冷下滑，Nuveen 投資長 Saira Malik 說：
「就就業市場而言，這項數據顯示就業並未蓬勃成長，甚至可能正在轉弱；但對市場來說，兩大主要疑慮仍是殖利率與通膨。這項較低的數據不會進一步強化 Fed 需要升息的論述。」
Integrity Asset Management 投資組合經理 Joe Gilbert 說：「隨著利率降溫，投資人重新轉向先前的科技股領導族群。」他指出，本周市場走強的原因之一，是 10 年期美債殖利率上周五觸頂。
Wilsey Asset Management 投資長 Brent Wilsey 表示：「雖然單一份疲弱的就業報告不太可能左右 Fed 的政策，但我們認為央行將維持利率『觀望等待』的做法，給予更多時間觀察後續經濟數據。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell, reducing the need for a Fed rate hike in September. U.S. stocks rose on Friday (the 7th), with the S&P 500 hitting a fresh all‑time high and posting a 3.6% weekly gain—the best performance since April and the second‑largest weekly rise of the year.

The S&P 500 logged a 3.6% rise this week after briefly breaking the 7,700‑point mark earlier in the week. The Nasdaq, boosted by chip stocks, jumped 5.2% for the week, while the Dow gained nearly 3%. All three major indices recorded their best weekly gains since April.

U.S. officials announced on Friday that July nonfarm payrolls fell by 23,000, far short of the market’s expectation of an increase of 83,000. The unemployment rate slipped to 4.1%, below the economists’ forecast of 4.2%, and the labor‑force participation rate fell to its lowest level in more than five years.

The CME FedWatch tool now shows traders broadly expecting the Fed to hold rates steady in September, keeping the target range at 3.50‑3.75%. By contrast, just a day earlier traders had assigned a 55% probability to a September rate hike.
President Trump reiterated his preference for lower interest rates in a Friday interview with Punchbowl News.

Meanwhile, oil prices edged higher as investors await a possible U.S.–Iran agreement and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent said earlier this week that the two sides could reach a deal soon.
Iran is reportedly still negotiating the wording of a Hormuz agreement with Oman, while Trump insists the deal is moving forward.

U.S. market performance on Friday (the 7th):

Dow Jones Industrial Average up 151.83 points, or 0.28%, to 54,063.93.
Nasdaq Composite up 342.26 points, or 1.30%, to 26,690.62.
S&P 500 up 47.68 points, or 0.62%, to 7,757.64.
Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 308.09 points, or 2.56%, to 12,356.79.
NYSE FANG+ Index up 301.95 points, or 1.64%, to 18,723.04.

Eight of the S&P’s 11 sector groups rose, led by basic materials and industrials, while energy, communication services and financials fell.

Spotlight stocks:

The five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ index mostly rose. Meta (META‑US) +0.37%; Apple (AAPL‑US) +0.29%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) –0.96%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) +0.03%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) +0.82%.

Semiconductor‑related stocks mostly advanced. Microchip (MCHP‑US) surged nearly 14%; Coherent (COHR‑US) jumped over 13%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) +4.66%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) +2.3%. Micron (MU‑US) –0.44%; AMD (AMD‑US) –1.21%.
Taiwan ADRs showed mixed moves. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) +0.44%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) +0.38%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) –2.50%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) +0.57%.

Corporate news:

Software stocks led the market higher on Friday as the latest earnings wave eased concerns that AI could upend the software sector. Cloudflare (NET‑US) jumped 5.8% after posting a strong full‑year and quarterly outlook; Atlassian (TEAM‑US) saw its Q4 adjusted earnings and revenue beat expectations and issued an upbeat forecast, sending the stock up 35%.
Microchip Technology (MCHP‑US) reported Q2 guidance that beat market estimates, lifting the share 13.9%.

Airbnb (ABNB‑US) surged 17.4% after the vacation‑rental platform posted Q2 revenue and earnings ahead of forecasts and raised its full‑year revenue outlook on the back of strong demand in the U.S. and Europe.

U.S. solar stocks rose after Trump ordered a 15% tariff on polysilicon‑derived products and set a minimum import price covering silicon wafers, solar cells and modules. First Solar (FSLR‑US) climbed 2.4%.

Wall Street commentary:

Regarding the surprisingly weak jobs data, Nuveen Chief Investment Officer Saira Malik said:

"For the labor market, this figure shows employment isn’t booming and may even be weakening; however, the market’s two main concerns remain yields and inflation. This lower number won’t further strengthen the case for a Fed rate hike."

Integrity Asset Management portfolio manager Joe Gilbert added: "As rates cool, investors are rotating back into the previously leading tech‑stock cohort." He noted that one reason for the market’s strength this week was the 10‑year Treasury yield topping out on Friday.

Wilsey Asset Management CIO Brent Wilsey said: "While a single weak jobs report is unlikely to dictate Fed policy, we believe the central bank will adopt a ‘wait‑and‑see’ stance on rates, giving more time to assess upcoming economic data."

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉荷姆茲海峽重啟仍添變數 原油漲逾1% 但周線仍跌逾8%
items.title_en: <Energy After-Hours> Hormuz Strait Reopening Still Uncertain, Crude Up Over 1% but Weekly Down Over 8%
paras: 國際油價周五 (7 日) 走高，市場持續關注伊朗戰事能否結束，以及荷姆茲海峽何時能全面恢復通航。由於伊朗與阿曼針對船舶通行路線的協議仍面臨美國是否接受等不確定性，交易員對全球原油供應恢復速度保持高度警戒，帶動布蘭特原油期貨價格單日上漲逾 1 美元。
布蘭特 (Brent) 原油期貨周五收於每桶 83.55 美元，上漲 1.06 美元或 1.3%；西德州中級原油 (WTI) 期貨則收於每桶 78.18 美元，上漲 89 美分或 1.15%。不過，在本周稍早市場一度認為伊朗衝突可能找到解決方案的情況下，油價此前已明顯走弱，Brent 原油本周仍可能下跌逾 8%，WTI 則可能下跌逾 7%。
油價周四已大漲逾 3 美元，主要受到伊朗局勢出現新的供應風險所刺激。伊朗正在審議一項禁止美國與以色列船舶通過荷姆茲海峽的法案，而這條位於伊朗與阿曼之間的重要航道，在戰事爆發前通常承擔全球約五分之一的石油與液化天然氣運輸。
自美國與以色列於 2 月下旬聯手對伊朗發動攻擊並引爆衝突以來，相關戰事如今已延續至第 6 個月。過去數周，市場情緒始終在「戰事即將結束」與「衝突可能進一步升級」兩種預期之間反覆擺盪，油價也隨著談判消息大幅震盪。
Vanda Insights 創辦人 Vandana Hari 表示，本周有關潛在協議的訊號已讓市場情緒呈現「坐雲霄飛車」般的劇烈變化，但市場目前仍無法確定究竟需要哪些條件才能讓協議真正敲定。
市場另一項關注焦點，是伊朗與阿曼針對荷姆茲海峽船舶通行所提出的安排。Lipow Oil Associates 總裁 Andrew Lipow 指出，市場正試圖判斷伊朗與阿曼達成的協議是否能讓懸掛美國國旗的船舶通過荷姆茲海峽，也關注美國持有的船舶是否能通行，以及前往美國港口的船舶是否能順利通過。
據了解，伊朗與阿曼已就船舶通過這條海峽的航行路線達成共識，但目前仍不清楚美國是否會接受相關條件。由於荷姆茲海峽是全球能源運輸最重要的航道之一，任何限制通行的措施都可能延長供應中斷時間，並進一步壓縮全球商業原油庫存。
分析師指出，本周局勢發展也顯示伊朗與美國之間的敵對狀態尚未真正結束，這使市場對戰事結束時間仍抱持高度不確定性。
在通行費問題上，伊朗要求使用荷姆茲海峽的船舶支付相當於貨物價值 5% 至 7% 的費用。一名伊朗高級官員透露相關要求後，阿曼方面則正在討論約 3% 的通行費，而美國則要求完全免除任何費用。
這項分歧可能成為協議能否落地的關鍵障礙。業界 4 名消息人士表示，目前提出的協議受到美國制裁以及保險條款限制，實際執行難度相當高，尤其是涉及向伊朗支付費用的安排，可能受到現有制裁制度與保險規定的限制。
SEB Research 分析師 Bjarne Schieldrop 表示，目前伊朗與阿曼協議的架構以及協議賦予伊朗的權力，從政治角度而言並非美國總統川普能夠接受的安排。他指出，如果川普接受相關條件，將可能在美國國內面臨強烈的政治批評。
另一方面，市場也擔心，只要荷姆茲海峽無法全面恢復正常通航，全球原油與能源庫存就會持續受到消耗。分析人士指出，供應中斷持續越久，全球商業庫存被動用的時間就越長，最終可能使能源市場面臨更大的供應壓力。
Again Capital 合夥人 John Kilduff 強調，市場需要的是荷姆茲海峽「全面重新開放」，而不是有限度或附帶條件的通航安排。他表示，戰事最終結果與結束時間持續充滿不確定性，使交易員始終處於高度焦慮狀態。
目前油市因此陷入雙重拉鋸。一方面，若伊朗與美國最終達成協議，且荷姆茲海峽恢復正常通航，先前因供應中斷而累積的風險溢價可能迅速消退，油價將面臨下行壓力；另一方面，若談判破裂、通航條件無法獲得美國接受，甚至進一步限制美國及以色列相關船舶通行，全球能源供應風險可能再次升高。
在這種背景下，儘管 Brent 原油與 WTI 周五雙雙反彈，但本周油價仍錄得大幅跌幅，顯示市場目前更關注的是伊朗戰事能否真正結束，以及荷姆茲海峽能否在沒有重大限制的情況下恢復全球能源運輸，而非單日價格波動本身。
paras_en: International oil prices rose on Friday (the 7th) as markets kept watching whether the Iran war can end and when the Hormuz Strait can fully resume navigation. Because the Iran‑Oman agreement on ship routing still faces uncertainty over U.S. acceptance, traders remain highly vigilant about the speed of global crude supply recovery, pushing Brent futures up more than $1 in a single day.

Brent crude futures closed on Friday at $83.55 a barrel, up $1.06 or 1.3%; West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures settled at $78.18, up 89 cents or 1.15%. However, earlier this week the market briefly thought a solution to the Iran conflict might be found, and oil prices had already weakened noticeably; Brent may still fall more than 8% this week and WTI more than 7%.

Oil prices had already jumped more than $3 on Thursday, mainly spurred by new supply risks from the Iran situation. Iran is reviewing a bill that would ban U.S. and Israeli vessels from transiting the Hormuz Strait, the key waterway between Iran and Oman that normally carries about one‑fifth of the world’s oil and liquefied natural gas before the war broke out.

Since the United States and Israel jointly launched attacks on Iran in late February, the conflict has now entered its sixth month. In recent weeks market sentiment has swung repeatedly between expectations that the war will end soon and that the conflict could further escalate, causing oil prices to swing sharply with negotiation news.

Vandana Hari, founder of Vanda Insights, said that signals of a potential agreement this week have made market sentiment swing like a roller coaster, but the market still cannot determine what conditions are needed for an agreement to be truly sealed.

Another market focus is the arrangement proposed by Iran and Oman for ship passage through the Hormuz Strait. Andrew Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates, noted that the market is trying to gauge whether the Iran‑Oman deal will allow U.S.-flagged vessels to pass, whether U.S.-owned ships can transit, and whether ships bound for U.S. ports can pass smoothly.

It is understood that Iran and Oman have reached a consensus on navigation routes for vessels through the strait, but it remains unclear whether the United States will accept the terms. Because the Hormuz Strait is one of the world’s most important energy transport routes, any restriction could lengthen supply‑disruption periods and further compress global commercial crude inventories.

Analysts pointed out that this week’s developments also show that the hostile stance between Iran and the United States has not truly ended, leaving the market highly uncertain about when the war will conclude.

Regarding transit fees, Iran demands ships using the Hormuz Strait pay a fee equal to 5%‑7% of the cargo value. After a senior Iranian official disclosed this demand, Oman is discussing a fee of about 3%, while the United States is demanding a complete waiver of any fee.

This divergence could become a key obstacle to the agreement’s implementation. Four industry sources said the proposed deal is hampered by U.S. sanctions and insurance‑policy restrictions, making actual execution very difficult, especially any arrangement that involves paying Iran, which could run afoul of existing sanctions and insurance rules.

SEB Research analyst Bjarne Schieldrop said the current structure of the Iran‑Oman agreement and the powers it grants Iran are not arrangements that former President Trump could accept politically. He noted that even if Trump accepted the terms, he would face strong domestic political criticism in the United States.

On the other hand, the market also worries that as long as the Hormuz Strait cannot fully resume normal navigation, global crude and energy inventories will continue to be drawn down. Analysts said the longer the supply disruption lasts, the longer commercial inventories will be tapped, eventually putting greater pressure on energy markets.

John Kilduff, a partner at Again Capital, emphasized that the market needs a “full reopening” of the Hormuz Strait, not a limited or conditional navigation arrangement. He said the ultimate outcome and timing of the war remain uncertain, keeping traders in a state of high anxiety.

The oil market is therefore caught in a double bind. If Iran and the United States eventually reach an agreement and the Hormuz Strait returns to normal navigation, the risk premium built up from the supply disruption could quickly evaporate, putting downward pressure on prices. Conversely, if negotiations break down, transit conditions are not accepted by the U.S., or further restrictions are placed on U.S. and Israeli vessels, global energy‑supply risk could rise again.

Against this backdrop, even though Brent and WTI both rebounded on Friday, oil prices still recorded a sharp weekly decline, showing that the market is currently more focused on whether the Iran war can truly end and whether the Hormuz Strait can resume global energy transport without major restrictions, rather than on single‑day price moves.

items.title: 美債殖利率終於有救？財政部暗示可能減發長債
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Finally Rescued? Treasury Department Hints at Possible Reduction of Long-Term Issuance
paras: 美國財政部本周調整債務發行措辭，引發市場猜測，政府可能縮減 20 年期與 30 年期公債標售規模，以壓低長期殖利率，打破市場多年來認定美債發行只會愈來愈多的看法。
美國長期維持龐大財政赤字，公債市場規模自 2018 年以來已增加逾一倍，達約 31 兆美元。財政部近年主要依賴一年內到期的短期國庫券滿足融資需求，但交易商普遍預期，政府最終仍須擴大中長期公債發行。
財政部周三在季度再融資聲明中表示，正評估附息債券標售的「未來潛在調整」，取代先前使用的「未來潛在增加」。由於財長貝森特長期將 10 年期美債殖利率視為衡量經濟的重要指標，這項措辭變化立即引發市場揣測：財政部可能限制長天期公債供給，未來新增發債則集中於融資成本較低的短中期券種。

道明證券 (TD Securities) 美國利率策略主管 Gennadiy Goldberg 認為，聲明暗示長天期供給未來可能下降，有助改善殖利率曲線長端的市場氣氛。長債近來面臨海外需求疲弱、全球殖利率上升、財政疑慮，以及 Alphabet 等科技巨頭為人工智慧 (AI) 投資大舉發債的多重壓力。TD 預估，財政部最快可能在明年 5 月削減 20 年期及 30 年期公債標售，同時增加 2 年至 10 年期公債發行。
不過，德意志銀行策略師 Steven Zeng 認為，考量政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行並非基本情境，財政部仍須從整條殖利率曲線籌措資金。他認為，措辭調整可能只是為了暫時降低市場對未來擴大標售的負面反應。
加拿大帝國商業銀行 (CIBC) 策略師 Michael Cloherty 更直言，縮減部分附息債券標售「根本還沒被列入考慮」。若為減少長債供給而大量增加短債發行，短端殖利率同樣可能因須吸引更多買家而上升。
2023 年美國財政部意外放緩長債增發，曾推動美債大漲，30 年期殖利率由當年 10 月接近 5.18% 的高點，年底降至略高於 4%。法國巴黎銀行策略師 Guneet Dhingra 認為，減少長債標售確實是壓低殖利率少數有力手段之一，但財政部若逐步釋放訊號，可能失去 2023 年政策突襲帶來的震撼效果。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury this week adjusted the wording of its debt issuance guidance, sparking market speculation that the government may shrink the auction size of 20‑year and 30‑year bonds to lower long‑term yields, challenging the long‑standing view that Treasury issuance will only keep increasing.

The United States has sustained a huge fiscal deficit, and the Treasury market has more than doubled since 2018 to about $31 trillion. In recent years the Treasury has relied mainly on short‑term Treasury bills maturing within a year to meet financing needs, but dealers generally expect the government will eventually have to expand medium‑ and long‑term bond issuance.

In its quarterly refinancing statement on Wednesday, the Treasury said it is evaluating a “future potential adjustment” to coupon‑bearing bond auctions, replacing the previously used phrase “future potential increase.” Because Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has long treated the 10‑year Treasury yield as a key economic gauge, the wording change immediately prompted market speculation: the Treasury may limit supply of long‑dated bonds, with any new issuance focused on lower‑cost short‑ and medium‑term securities.

Gennadiy Goldberg, head of U.S. rates strategy at TD Securities, said the statement suggests that long‑dated supply could fall, which would help improve sentiment at the long end of the yield curve. Long bonds have recently faced weak overseas demand, rising global yields, fiscal concerns, and pressure from tech giants such as Alphabet issuing large amounts of debt to fund AI investments. TD estimates the Treasury could cut 20‑year and 30‑year auction sizes as early as May next year, while increasing issuance of 2‑year to 10‑year bonds.

However, Deutsche Bank strategist Steven Zeng argued that given the government’s massive financing needs, cutting long‑bond issuance is not a baseline scenario; the Treasury still has to raise funds across the entire yield curve. He believes the wording tweak may simply be intended to temporarily soften market reaction to any future expansion of auctions.

CIBC strategist Michael Cloherty was even more blunt, saying that a reduction in some coupon‑bearing auctions “has not even been put on the table.” If the Treasury were to sharply increase short‑term issuance to offset reduced long‑bond supply, short‑end yields could also rise as they would need to attract more buyers.

In 2023 the Treasury unexpectedly slowed the pace of new long‑bond issuance, which helped drive a sharp rally in Treasuries; the 30‑year yield fell from a near‑5.18 % peak in October that year to just above 4 % by year‑end. BNP Paribas strategist Guneet Dhingra said that reducing long‑bond auctions is indeed one of the few effective ways to push yields lower, but if the Treasury releases the signal gradually it may lose the shock impact that the 2023 policy surprise delivered.

items.title: 賴清德：0-18歲每月5千津貼明年上路 籲「此時不生更待何時」
items.title_en: President Lai Ching-te: NT$50,000 Monthly Subsidy for 0-18 Year-Olds to Launch Next Year, Urging 'Not to Wait Any Longer'
paras: 總統賴清德今 (7) 日出席「總統府暨國家安全會議員工家庭日」，在致詞時除了感謝每位父親照顧家庭，也針對國人育兒政策，提及 0 至 18 歲成長津貼已編入明 (2027) 年度總預算，明年將正式上路，屆時符合者每月可領取 5,000 元，也喊出「此時不生，更待何時」，鼓勵國人積極生育。
賴清德說，明天就是父親節，他要預祝府內同仁及全國的父親「父親節快樂」，感謝每位父親除了照顧家庭，也在各行各業為國家的進步發展做出貢獻。
賴清德指出，在國人共同努力下，台灣這幾年經濟非常好，今年上半年經濟成長率 13.72%，是 50 年來同期表現最好；明年度中央政府總預算籌編，更創下 78 年來首度不用舉債的歷史紀錄。
賴清德強調，為了讓經濟成長的果實由全民共享，政府不斷推出加薪、減稅、增福利、少負擔的政策，不斷升級加碼，今年 5 月政府更宣布推動「台灣人口對策新戰略 - 家庭支持篇」，透過「加補助、減負擔、多彈性、增照顧」四大策略，共 18 項措施，將「補助式育兒」全面升級為「公共支持式育兒」，讓台灣年輕世代獲得更大支持。
賴清德也指出，明年現場的小朋友、18 歲以下的年輕朋友，就可以領到每月 5,000 元的「0 到 18 歲成長津貼」，經費已經編入明年度總預算，政府也推動「育兒留停 6+3」，雙親各自請滿 6 個月育兒留停津貼後，可各再多領 3 個月，並提出婚假延長為 14 天，產假從 8 周延長到 12 周，陪產檢及陪產假也從 7 天增加到 14 天，擴大對家庭的支持。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te attended the 'Presidential Office and National Security Council Staff Family Day' today (7) and, in his speech, expressed gratitude to every father for taking care of their families. He also mentioned the 0-18 year-old growth allowance, which has been included in the 2027 budget, and will officially launch next year, allowing eligible individuals to receive NT$50,000 per month. He also urged people to 'not wait any longer' and encourage active reproduction.

President Lai Ching-te said that tomorrow is Father's Day, and he wants to wish all the fathers in the Presidential Office and across the country 'Happy Father's Day.' He thanked every father not only for taking care of their families but also for contributing to the country's progress and development.

President Lai Ching-te pointed out that, thanks to the joint efforts of the people, Taiwan's economy has been very good in recent years. The economic growth rate for the first half of this year was 13.72%, the best performance in the past 50 years. The central government's budget for next year has also set a new record, with a budget of NT$78 billion, the first time in 78 years that the government has not had to borrow money.

President Lai Ching-te emphasized that in order to let the fruits of economic growth be shared by all, the government has been continuously introducing policies such as pay raises, tax cuts, increased welfare, and reduced burdens. The government has also upgraded and added to these policies, including the announcement in May of the 'Taiwan Population Countermeasures New Strategy - Family Support Edition,' which aims to promote 'public support for child-rearing' through four strategies: 'increased subsidies, reduced burdens, increased flexibility, and increased care.'

President Lai Ching-te also pointed out that next year, children and young people under the age of 18 will be able to receive NT$50,000 per month in '0-18 year-old growth allowance,' which has already been included in the budget for next year. The government has also promoted the 'Leave and Stay 6+3' policy, which allows parents to take 6 months of leave and stay with their children, and then receive an additional 3 months of leave. The government has also extended maternity leave from 8 weeks to 12 weeks, and increased paternity leave from 7 days to 14 days, and expanded support for families.

items.title: SK海力士擴產嚇跌美光 但新產能遠水救不了近火
items.title_en: SK Hynix Expands Production, Scares Micron, Yet New Capacity Won’t Extinguish the Immediate Fire
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 周五早盤下跌 3.6% 至 849.80 美元，市場一度擔憂南韓競爭對手 SK 海力士 (SK Hynix)(SKHY-US) 大舉擴產，恐加速記憶體供需反轉。不過，《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s) 認為，晶圓廠從興建到投產需時多年，SK 海力士的投資短期內不會增加市場供給，因此不太可能對美光構成長期威脅。
美光股價過去一個月累計下跌 10%，但過去 12 個月仍暴漲逾 600%。隨著人工智慧 (AI) 硬體對記憶體需求激增，投資人正密切關注供給何時追上需求，以及目前的記憶體漲價周期能維持多久。
SK 海力士周五宣布，董事會已批准投入 54.3 兆韓元 (約 381.5 億美元)，在南韓興建新的晶片製造設施。雖然金額龐大，但市場其實早已得知規模更驚人的擴產計畫。SK 海力士與三星電子 6 月曾宣布，將合計投入 800 兆韓元 (約 5,185.8 億美元)，在南韓西南部打造新的晶片製造聚落。
大型晶圓廠通常需要數年才能完工。美光早在 2022 年就宣布於紐約州投資 1,000 億美元興建晶片廠，但預計要到 2030 年才會開始生產。《巴隆周刊》指出，未來約一年內不會有新的大型記憶體產能投入市場，更多產能則要等到 2028 年才會陸續開出。
這意味記憶體供應緊張情況短期難以緩解，價格未來數年仍可能持續攀升。瑞銀 (UBS) 分析師預估，記憶體價格今年將上漲逾 200%，2027 年再上漲 89%。
瑞銀經濟學家 Arend Kapteyn 指出，2026 年 AI 資本支出增量中，約 60% 將來自記憶體價格上漲；到了 2027 年，這一比率更可能高達 97%。因此，SK 海力士大舉擴產雖造成記憶體股短線震盪，卻不會立即改變供不應求的格局。SK 海力士美國存託憑證周五下跌 6.2%，南韓掛牌股票則收跌 4.9%。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) fell 3.6% to $849.80 in early trade on Friday, prompting market worries that South Korean rival SK Hynix (SKHY-US) might ramp up production and accelerate a memory supply‑demand reversal. However, Barron’s notes that building a fab takes years, so SK Hynix’s investment will not boost supply in the short term and is unlikely to pose a long‑term threat to Micron.

Micron’s stock has dropped 10% over the past month but has still surged more than 600% in the last 12 months. With AI hardware driving a surge in memory demand, investors are closely watching when supply can catch up and how long the current memory price‑rise cycle can be sustained.

SK Hynix announced on Friday that its board approved a 54.3‑trillion‑won (about $38.15 billion) investment to build new chip‑manufacturing facilities in South Korea. Although the sum is large, the market had already been aware of an even bigger expansion plan. In June, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics said they would jointly invest 800 trillion won (about $518.58 billion) to create a new chip‑manufacturing hub in the southwest of South Korea.

Large fabs typically take several years to complete. Micron announced in 2022 that it would invest $100 billion in a New York‑state chip plant, which is not expected to start production until 2030. Barron’s points out that no new large‑scale memory capacity will enter the market within the next year, and additional capacity won’t come online until around 2028.

This means the tight memory supply situation is unlikely to ease in the short term, and prices could keep climbing for several years. UBS analysts project memory prices to rise more than 200% this year and another 89% by 2027.

UBS economist Arend Kapteyn notes that about 60% of the incremental AI capital spending in 2026 will stem from rising memory prices, a share that could jump to 97% in 2027. Thus, while SK Hynix’s massive expansion may cause short‑term volatility in memory stocks, it will not immediately change the oversupply‑deficit dynamic. SK Hynix’s American Depositary Receipts fell 6.2% on Friday, and its South Korean‑listed shares dropped 4.9%.

items.title: 不再是崩盤代名詞！價值股大勝成長股 專家：AI擴散助長多頭行情
items.title_en: No Longer Synonymous with Collapse! Value Stocks Outperform Growth Stocks, Experts Say AI Diffusion Fuels Bull Market
paras: 歷史上，幾乎每當價值股發光發熱，通常意味著大盤正陷入崩跌，但這一次情況不同：在這波多頭行情即將邁入第四年、主要股指持續在歷史高檔震盪的情況下，羅素 1000 價值股指數 (RLV) 卻大幅跑贏羅素 1000 成長股指數(RLG)。
根據 Nationwide 彙整的數據，過去一年來，羅素 1000 價值股指數上漲 31.6%，成長股指數則上漲 13.5%。以過去 12 個月的相對報酬率計算，兩者的績效差距一度擴大至 2022 年熊市以來最大，截至上周約為 22%。
不過，當前領漲的價值股，與可口可樂 (KO-US) 和康卡斯特 (Comcast)(CMCSA-US) 等傳統價值股代表已大不相同。羅素價值股指數今年表現強勁，其中一項原因正是指數持股中有許多科技股，而科技股過去較常被視為成長股。
目前亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 已成為羅素價值股指數最大成分股，其次為蘋果 (AAPL-US) 和微軟(MSFT-US)，這兩家公司同時也是羅素成長股指數的主要持股。
今年初，價值股的好表現有一部分要歸功於美光科技 (MU-US) 等熱門晶片股被納入指數。不過，6 月高飛的美光在最新一次指數再平衡中遭移出，時間就在半導體行情觸頂之際，正好讓價值股投資人躲過一劫。
這並未改變價值股通常在成長股表現不佳時取得相對優勢的事實。在 2022 年之前，羅素價值股指數上一次出現如此強勁的超額報酬，網路泡沫即將到達高峰。
價值股在 8 月持續上漲，反而顯示這波股市漲勢已開始明顯擴散至人工智慧 (AI) 交易以外。美國經濟展現韌性，加上 AI 帶動廣泛生產力提升的預期，也讓更多類股受惠。
Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Mark Hackett 說：「市場廣度擴大的其中一項證據，就是價值股跑贏成長股，因為價值股涵蓋的個股更多元、分布也更廣。」他指出，價值股並非單押一項交易，而是涵蓋金融股、其他景氣循環股、防禦型股票及債券替代股。
Hackett 認為，這種情況與其說是股市潛在問題，反而對多頭行情是正面訊號。
過去價值股勝出有著直觀的邏輯： 股市下跌時，投資人通常會撤出成長股，尤其是估值高度依賴未來獲利預期的科技股。一旦利率飆升或市場情緒轉差，這類股票往往首當其衝。
相較之下，投資人通常偏好價值股，大多是必需消費品、公用事業及醫療保健等傳統防禦型產業。這些企業通常獲利較穩定、現金流可預測且估值較低，因此市場走弱時具有較強的下檔保護，同時通常也提供較高股息率，對尋求穩定收益的投資人更具吸引力。
但這次情況不同，股市即將進入多頭行情第四年，AI 仍是推動漲勢的主要引擎，大型 AI 基礎建設帶來的資本支出也處於歷史高檔。美國經濟雖然成長步伐較為放緩，但仍持續擴張，消費者支出也展現韌性。
對習慣看到價值股與成長股明顯分野的投資人而言，富時羅素 (FTSE Russell) 如今將許多大型科技股視為同時具備價值與成長特徵，也反映價值因子的定義正在改變。分析師指出，目前價值因子更看重獲利品質。
富時羅素美國指數產品管理主管 Catherine Yoshimoto 表示，羅素 1000 指數約 35% 的市值純粹屬於成長股，約 35% 純粹屬於價值股，另有約 30% 無法明確歸類，因此這些公司的股票會依其風格機率分配至不同指數。
富時羅素並非將公司硬性歸入單一類別，而是根據股價淨值比、未來兩年預估獲利成長及過去五年營收成長等指標計算風格機率，再按比例將股票市值分配至成長股與價值股指數。這也讓大型科技股能同時出現在兩類指數中。
因此，當前市場並不是成長股崩跌、價值股獨漲，而是在成長股仍維持雙位數報酬的同時，價值股漲勢更為強勁。
此外，隨著 AI 交易逐漸成熟，投資人的目光也從早期 AI 龍頭擴大至半導體及其他 AI 支出的第二、第三階段受惠者。富時羅素全球投資研究主管 Indrani De 指出，這些企業規模較小、更偏向價值股，估值也更具吸引力。
相較 2010 年代的超低利率環境，目前利率也更接近歷史正常水準，這同樣有利於價值股持續受到投資人青睞。
De 說：「我們都已習慣金融危機後成長股持續領先價值股的世界。但要記住，那是一個利率極低的世界。」她指出，目前市場正進入類似金融危機前的正常化利率環境，殖利率曲線也呈現向上傾斜，這是明顯有利價值股勝過成長股的環境。
第 2 季企業財報季已近尾聲，到目前為止科技股獲利表現非常強勁，但這也意味著明年將面臨較高的比較基期，尤其是隸屬「科技七巨頭」的那些大型科技股。相較之下，醫療保健及金融等價值型產業 2027 年第 2 季面臨的獲利比較基期較低，反而有機會持續取得相對優勢。
這使 Hackett 認為，價值股可能維持強勢表現，不只是「幾季行情」。
paras_en: Historically, whenever value stocks have shone, it usually meant the broader market was in a crash, but this time the situation is different: as the current bull market approaches its fourth year and major indices continue to oscillate near historic highs, the Russell 1000 Value Index (RLV) has vastly outperformed the Russell 1000 Growth Index (RLG).

According to data compiled by Nationwide, over the past year the Russell 1000 Value Index rose 31.6% while the Growth Index gained 13.5%. Calculated on a 12‑month relative return basis, the performance gap between the two widened to its largest since the 2022 bear market, reaching about 22% as of last week.

However, today’s leading value stocks are very different from traditional value representatives such as Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) and Comcast (CMCSA‑US). The Russell Value Index has been strong this year, partly because many of its holdings are technology stocks that were previously classified as growth stocks.
Amazon (AMZN‑US) is now the largest component of the Russell Value Index, followed by Apple (AAPL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US), which are also major holdings in the Russell Growth Index.

Early this year the strong performance of value stocks was helped in part by hot chip makers like Micron Technology (MU‑US) being added to the index. In June, however, Micron was removed in the latest rebalancing, just as the semiconductor rally peaked, allowing value investors to avoid a hit.

This does not change the fact that value stocks usually gain a relative edge when growth stocks lag. The last time the Russell Value Index delivered such a strong excess return before 2022 was during the peak of the dot‑com bubble.

Value stocks kept rising in August, indicating that the market rally is now spreading well beyond AI‑driven trading. A resilient U.S. economy combined with expectations that AI will boost productivity across the board is benefiting a broader set of sectors.

Nationwide chief market strategist Mark Hackett said, “One sign of expanding market breadth is value outpacing growth, because value covers a more diverse and wider range of stocks.” He noted that value is not a single bet but includes financials, other cyclical stocks, defensive equities and bond‑proxy stocks.
Hackett believes this situation is less a market flaw and more a positive signal for the ongoing bull market.

The logic behind value’s past outperformance is straightforward: when markets fall, investors typically pull out of growth stocks, especially tech stocks whose valuations rely heavily on future earnings expectations. A spike in rates or a shift in sentiment hits those stocks first.

By contrast, investors tend to favor value stocks, which are often consumer staples, utilities and healthcare—traditional defensive industries. These companies usually have steadier earnings, predictable cash flow and lower valuations, providing stronger downside protection in weak markets and often higher dividend yields that appeal to income‑seeking investors.

But this time is different: the market is entering the fourth year of a bull run, AI remains the main engine of the rally, and capital spending on large‑scale AI infrastructure is at historic highs. Although U.S. growth has slowed, the economy is still expanding and consumer spending remains resilient.

For investors accustomed to a clear split between value and growth, FTSE Russell now classifies many large tech stocks as having both value and growth characteristics, reflecting a shift in how the value factor is defined. Analysts say the value factor now places more emphasis on profit quality.

Catherine Yoshimoto, head of U.S. index product management at FTSE Russell, said roughly 35% of the Russell 1000’s market cap is pure growth, about 35% is pure value, and the remaining ~30% cannot be clearly classified, so those stocks are probabilistically allocated across the two indices.

FTSE Russell does not force a company into a single bucket; instead it calculates style probabilities based on price‑to‑book, projected earnings growth over the next two years and revenue growth over the past five years, then assigns market cap to growth and value indices proportionally. This allows large tech stocks to appear in both indices.

Thus, the current market is not a scenario of growth stocks crashing while value climbs alone; growth stocks are still delivering double‑digit returns, but value stocks are advancing even more strongly.

Moreover, as AI trading matures, investors’ focus is expanding from early AI leaders to second‑ and third‑stage beneficiaries in semiconductors and other AI‑related spend. FTSE Russell global investment research head Indrani De notes that these smaller, more value‑oriented companies have more attractive valuations.
Compared with the ultra‑low‑rate environment of the 2010s, today’s rates are closer to historic normals, which also benefits value stocks that continue to attract investor interest.

De said, “We’ve become accustomed to a post‑financial‑crisis world where growth outperforms value. But remember, that was a world of extremely low rates.” She added that the market is now moving into a normal‑rate environment similar to pre‑crisis levels, with an upward‑sloping yield curve, which clearly favors value over growth.

The second‑quarter earnings season is winding down, and so far tech earnings have been very strong, but that also means a higher comparative base for next year, especially for the mega‑cap “big‑seven” tech stocks. By contrast, value‑oriented sectors such as healthcare and finance face a lower profit base in Q2 2027, giving them a chance to maintain a relative edge.
Hackett concludes that value stocks may stay strong, not just for a few quarters, but for an extended period.

items.title: 賴清德：0-18歲每月5千津貼明年上路 籲「此時不生更待何時」
items.title_en: President Lai Ching-te: NT$50,000 Monthly Subsidy for 0-18 Year-Olds to Launch Next Year, Urging 'Not to Wait Any Longer'
paras: 總統賴清德今 (7) 日出席「總統府暨國家安全會議員工家庭日」，在致詞時除了感謝每位父親照顧家庭，也針對國人育兒政策，提及 0 至 18 歲成長津貼已編入明 (2027) 年度總預算，明年將正式上路，屆時符合者每月可領取 5,000 元，也喊出「此時不生，更待何時」，鼓勵國人積極生育。
賴清德說，明天就是父親節，他要預祝府內同仁及全國的父親「父親節快樂」，感謝每位父親除了照顧家庭，也在各行各業為國家的進步發展做出貢獻。
賴清德指出，在國人共同努力下，台灣這幾年經濟非常好，今年上半年經濟成長率 13.72%，是 50 年來同期表現最好；明年度中央政府總預算籌編，更創下 78 年來首度不用舉債的歷史紀錄。
賴清德強調，為了讓經濟成長的果實由全民共享，政府不斷推出加薪、減稅、增福利、少負擔的政策，不斷升級加碼，今年 5 月政府更宣布推動「台灣人口對策新戰略 - 家庭支持篇」，透過「加補助、減負擔、多彈性、增照顧」四大策略，共 18 項措施，將「補助式育兒」全面升級為「公共支持式育兒」，讓台灣年輕世代獲得更大支持。
賴清德也指出，明年現場的小朋友、18 歲以下的年輕朋友，就可以領到每月 5,000 元的「0 到 18 歲成長津貼」，經費已經編入明年度總預算，政府也推動「育兒留停 6+3」，雙親各自請滿 6 個月育兒留停津貼後，可各再多領 3 個月，並提出婚假延長為 14 天，產假從 8 周延長到 12 周，陪產檢及陪產假也從 7 天增加到 14 天，擴大對家庭的支持。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te attended the 'Presidential Office and National Security Council Staff Family Day' today (7) and, in his speech, expressed gratitude to every father for taking care of their families. He also mentioned the 0-18 year-old growth allowance, which has been included in the 2027 budget, and will officially launch next year, allowing eligible individuals to receive NT$50,000 per month. He also urged people to 'not wait any longer' and encourage active reproduction.

President Lai Ching-te said that tomorrow is Father's Day, and he wants to wish all the fathers in the Presidential Office and across the country 'Happy Father's Day.' He thanked every father not only for taking care of their families but also for contributing to the country's progress and development.

President Lai Ching-te pointed out that, thanks to the joint efforts of the people, Taiwan's economy has been very good in recent years. The economic growth rate for the first half of this year was 13.72%, the best performance in the past 50 years. The central government's budget for next year has also set a new record, with a budget of NT$78 billion, the first time in 78 years that the government has not had to borrow money.

President Lai Ching-te emphasized that in order to let the fruits of economic growth be shared by all, the government has been continuously introducing policies such as pay raises, tax cuts, increased welfare, and reduced burdens. The government has also upgraded and added to these policies, including the announcement in May of the 'Taiwan Population Countermeasures New Strategy - Family Support Edition,' which aims to promote 'public support for child-rearing' through four strategies: 'increased subsidies, reduced burdens, increased flexibility, and increased care.'

President Lai Ching-te also pointed out that next year, children and young people under the age of 18 will be able to receive NT$50,000 per month in '0-18 year-old growth allowance,' which has already been included in the budget for next year. The government has also promoted the 'Leave and Stay 6+3' policy, which allows parents to take 6 months of leave and stay with their children, and then receive an additional 3 months of leave. The government has also extended maternity leave from 8 weeks to 12 weeks, and increased paternity leave from 7 days to 14 days, and expanded support for families.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Cold Nonfarm Payrolls Slash Fed Rate‑Hike Odds; S&P Hits New High, Weekly Gain 3.6% Best Since April
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，降低聯準會 (Fed)9 月升息的必要性，美股周五(7 日) 上漲，標普 500 指數創新高，並以單周上漲 3.6% 寫下 4 月以來最佳表現，也是今年來第二大單周漲幅。
標普本周稍早才首度登上 7700 點，本周累計上漲 3.6%。那斯達克在晶片股帶動下，本周上漲 5.2%，道瓊一周上漲將近 3%。這三大指數都創下 4 月以來最佳單周。
美國周五公布 7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，遠不及市場所估的增加 8.3 萬人。失業率降到 4.1%，低於經濟學家預測的 4.2%，勞動參與率降至超過五年來最低水準。
芝商所 (CME)FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員如今普遍預測，Fed 9 月很可能按兵不動，把利率維持在 3.50-3.75% 區間。相形之下，交易員一天前還認為 9 月會有 55% 的機率升息。
美國總統川普周五接受 Punchbowl News 訪問時，再度重申偏好較低利率。

企業新聞

paras_en: U.S. July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell, reducing the need for a Fed rate hike in September. U.S. stocks rose on Friday (the 7th), with the S&P 500 hitting a fresh all‑time high and posting a 3.6% weekly gain—the best performance since April and the second‑largest weekly rise of the year.

The S&P 500 logged a 3.6% rise this week after briefly breaking the 7,700‑point mark earlier in the week. The Nasdaq, boosted by chip stocks, jumped 5.2% for the week, while the Dow gained nearly 3%. All three major indices recorded their best weekly gains since April.

U.S. officials announced on Friday that July nonfarm payrolls fell by 23,000, far short of the market’s expectation of an increase of 83,000. The unemployment rate slipped to 4.1%, below the economists’ forecast of 4.2%, and the labor‑force participation rate fell to its lowest level in more than five years.

The CME FedWatch tool now shows traders broadly expecting the Fed to hold rates steady in September, keeping the target range at 3.50‑3.75%. By contrast, just a day earlier traders had assigned a 55% probability to a September rate hike.
President Trump reiterated his preference for lower interest rates in a Friday interview with Punchbowl News.

Meanwhile, oil prices edged higher as investors await a possible U.S.–Iran agreement and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent said earlier this week that the two sides could reach a deal soon.
Iran is reportedly still negotiating the wording of a Hormuz agreement with Oman, while Trump insists the deal is moving forward.

Dow Jones Industrial Average up 151.83 points, or 0.28%, to 54,063.93.

The five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ index mostly rose. Meta (META‑US) +0.37%; Apple (AAPL‑US) +0.29%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) –0.96%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) +0.03%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) +0.82%.

Software stocks led the market higher on Friday as the latest earnings wave eased concerns that AI could upend the software sector. Cloudflare (NET‑US) jumped 5.8% after posting a strong full‑year and quarterly outlook; Atlassian (TEAM‑US) saw its Q4 adjusted earnings and revenue beat expectations and issued an upbeat forecast, sending the stock up 35%.

items.title: 美債殖利率終於有救？財政部暗示可能減發長債
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Finally Rescued? Treasury Department Hints at Possible Reduction of Long-Term Issuance
paras: 美國財政部本周調整債務發行措辭，引發市場猜測，政府可能縮減 20 年期與 30 年期公債標售規模，以壓低長期殖利率，打破市場多年來認定美債發行只會愈來愈多的看法。
美國長期維持龐大財政赤字，公債市場規模自 2018 年以來已增加逾一倍，達約 31 兆美元。財政部近年主要依賴一年內到期的短期國庫券滿足融資需求，但交易商普遍預期，政府最終仍須擴大中長期公債發行。
財政部周三在季度再融資聲明中表示，正評估附息債券標售的「未來潛在調整」，取代先前使用的「未來潛在增加」。由於財長貝森特長期將 10 年期美債殖利率視為衡量經濟的重要指標，這項措辭變化立即引發市場揣測：財政部可能限制長天期公債供給，未來新增發債則集中於融資成本較低的短中期券種。

道明證券 (TD Securities) 美國利率策略主管 Gennadiy Goldberg 認為，聲明暗示長天期供給未來可能下降，有助改善殖利率曲線長端的市場氣氛。長債近來面臨海外需求疲弱、全球殖利率上升、財政疑慮，以及 Alphabet 等科技巨頭為人工智慧 (AI) 投資大舉發債的多重壓力。TD 預估，財政部最快可能在明年 5 月削減 20 年期及 30 年期公債標售，同時增加 2 年至 10 年期公債發行。
不過，德意志銀行策略師 Steven Zeng 認為，考量政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行並非基本情境，財政部仍須從整條殖利率曲線籌措資金。他認為，措辭調整可能只是為了暫時降低市場對未來擴大標售的負面反應。
加拿大帝國商業銀行 (CIBC) 策略師 Michael Cloherty 更直言，縮減部分附息債券標售「根本還沒被列入考慮」。若為減少長債供給而大量增加短債發行，短端殖利率同樣可能因須吸引更多買家而上升。
2023 年美國財政部意外放緩長債增發，曾推動美債大漲，30 年期殖利率由當年 10 月接近 5.18% 的高點，年底降至略高於 4%。法國巴黎銀行策略師 Guneet Dhingra 認為，減少長債標售確實是壓低殖利率少數有力手段之一，但財政部若逐步釋放訊號，可能失去 2023 年政策突襲帶來的震撼效果。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury this week adjusted the wording of its debt issuance guidance, sparking market speculation that the government may shrink the auction size of 20‑year and 30‑year bonds to lower long‑term yields, challenging the long‑standing view that Treasury issuance will only keep increasing.

The United States has sustained a huge fiscal deficit, and the Treasury market has more than doubled since 2018 to about $31 trillion. In recent years the Treasury has relied mainly on short‑term Treasury bills maturing within a year to meet financing needs, but dealers generally expect the government will eventually have to expand medium‑ and long‑term bond issuance.

In its quarterly refinancing statement on Wednesday, the Treasury said it is evaluating a “future potential adjustment” to coupon‑bearing bond auctions, replacing the previously used phrase “future potential increase.” Because Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has long treated the 10‑year Treasury yield as a key economic gauge, the wording change immediately prompted market speculation: the Treasury may limit supply of long‑dated bonds, with any new issuance focused on lower‑cost short‑ and medium‑term securities.

Gennadiy Goldberg, head of U.S. rates strategy at TD Securities, said the statement suggests that long‑dated supply could fall, which would help improve sentiment at the long end of the yield curve. Long bonds have recently faced weak overseas demand, rising global yields, fiscal concerns, and pressure from tech giants such as Alphabet issuing large amounts of debt to fund AI investments. TD estimates the Treasury could cut 20‑year and 30‑year auction sizes as early as May next year, while increasing issuance of 2‑year to 10‑year bonds.

However, Deutsche Bank strategist Steven Zeng argued that given the government’s massive financing needs, cutting long‑bond issuance is not a baseline scenario; the Treasury still has to raise funds across the entire yield curve. He believes the wording tweak may simply be intended to temporarily soften market reaction to any future expansion of auctions.

CIBC strategist Michael Cloherty was even more blunt, saying that a reduction in some coupon‑bearing auctions “has not even been put on the table.” If the Treasury were to sharply increase short‑term issuance to offset reduced long‑bond supply, short‑end yields could also rise as they would need to attract more buyers.

In 2023 the Treasury unexpectedly slowed the pace of new long‑bond issuance, which helped drive a sharp rally in Treasuries; the 30‑year yield fell from a near‑5.18 % peak in October that year to just above 4 % by year‑end. BNP Paribas strategist Guneet Dhingra said that reducing long‑bond auctions is indeed one of the few effective ways to push yields lower, but if the Treasury releases the signal gradually it may lose the shock impact that the 2023 policy surprise delivered.

美光股價過去一個月累計下跌 10%，但過去 12 個月仍暴漲逾 600%。隨著人工智慧 (AI) 硬體對記憶體需求激增，投資人正密切關注供給何時追上需求，以及目前的記憶體漲價周期能維持多久。
SK 海力士周五宣布，董事會已批准投入 54.3 兆韓元 (約 381.5 億美元)，在南韓興建新的晶片製造設施。雖然金額龐大，但市場其實早已得知規模更驚人的擴產計畫。SK 海力士與三星電子 6 月曾宣布，將合計投入 800 兆韓元 (約 5,185.8 億美元)，在南韓西南部打造新的晶片製造聚落。
大型晶圓廠通常需要數年才能完工。美光早在 2022 年就宣布於紐約州投資 1,000 億美元興建晶片廠，但預計要到 2030 年才會開始生產。《巴隆周刊》指出，未來約一年內不會有新的大型記憶體產能投入市場，更多產能則要等到 2028 年才會陸續開出。
這意味記憶體供應緊張情況短期難以緩解，價格未來數年仍可能持續攀升。瑞銀 (UBS) 分析師預估，記憶體價格今年將上漲逾 200%，2027 年再上漲 89%。
瑞銀經濟學家 Arend Kapteyn 指出，2026 年 AI 資本支出增量中，約 60% 將來自記憶體價格上漲；到了 2027 年，這一比率更可能高達 97%。因此，SK 海力士大舉擴產雖造成記憶體股短線震盪，卻不會立即改變供不應求的格局。SK 海力士美國存託憑證周五下跌 6.2%，南韓掛牌股票則收跌 4.9%。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) fell 3.6% to $849.80 in early trade on Friday, prompting market worries that South Korean rival SK Hynix (SKHY-US) might ramp up production and accelerate a memory supply‑demand reversal. However, Barron’s notes that building a fab takes years, so SK Hynix’s investment will not boost supply in the short term and is unlikely to pose a long‑term threat to Micron.

Micron’s stock has dropped 10% over the past month but has still surged more than 600% in the last 12 months. With AI hardware driving a surge in memory demand, investors are closely watching when supply can catch up and how long the current memory price‑rise cycle can be sustained.

SK Hynix announced on Friday that its board approved a 54.3‑trillion‑won (about $38.15 billion) investment to build new chip‑manufacturing facilities in South Korea. Although the sum is large, the market had already been aware of an even bigger expansion plan. In June, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics said they would jointly invest 800 trillion won (about $518.58 billion) to create a new chip‑manufacturing hub in the southwest of South Korea.

Large fabs typically take several years to complete. Micron announced in 2022 that it would invest $100 billion in a New York‑state chip plant, which is not expected to start production until 2030. Barron’s points out that no new large‑scale memory capacity will enter the market within the next year, and additional capacity won’t come online until around 2028.

This means the tight memory supply situation is unlikely to ease in the short term, and prices could keep climbing for several years. UBS analysts project memory prices to rise more than 200% this year and another 89% by 2027.

UBS economist Arend Kapteyn notes that about 60% of the incremental AI capital spending in 2026 will stem from rising memory prices, a share that could jump to 97% in 2027. Thus, while SK Hynix’s massive expansion may cause short‑term volatility in memory stocks, it will not immediately change the oversupply‑deficit dynamic. SK Hynix’s American Depositary Receipts fell 6.2% on Friday, and its South Korean‑listed shares dropped 4.9%.

items.title: 不再是崩盤代名詞！價值股大勝成長股 專家：AI擴散助長多頭行情
items.title_en: No Longer Synonymous with Collapse! Value Stocks Outperform Growth Stocks, Experts Say AI Diffusion Fuels Bull Market
paras: 歷史上，幾乎每當價值股發光發熱，通常意味著大盤正陷入崩跌，但這一次情況不同：在這波多頭行情即將邁入第四年、主要股指持續在歷史高檔震盪的情況下，羅素 1000 價值股指數 (RLV) 卻大幅跑贏羅素 1000 成長股指數(RLG)。
根據 Nationwide 彙整的數據，過去一年來，羅素 1000 價值股指數上漲 31.6%，成長股指數則上漲 13.5%。以過去 12 個月的相對報酬率計算，兩者的績效差距一度擴大至 2022 年熊市以來最大，截至上周約為 22%。
不過，當前領漲的價值股，與可口可樂 (KO-US) 和康卡斯特 (Comcast)(CMCSA-US) 等傳統價值股代表已大不相同。羅素價值股指數今年表現強勁，其中一項原因正是指數持股中有許多科技股，而科技股過去較常被視為成長股。
目前亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 已成為羅素價值股指數最大成分股，其次為蘋果 (AAPL-US) 和微軟(MSFT-US)，這兩家公司同時也是羅素成長股指數的主要持股。
今年初，價值股的好表現有一部分要歸功於美光科技 (MU-US) 等熱門晶片股被納入指數。不過，6 月高飛的美光在最新一次指數再平衡中遭移出，時間就在半導體行情觸頂之際，正好讓價值股投資人躲過一劫。
這並未改變價值股通常在成長股表現不佳時取得相對優勢的事實。在 2022 年之前，羅素價值股指數上一次出現如此強勁的超額報酬，網路泡沫即將到達高峰。
價值股在 8 月持續上漲，反而顯示這波股市漲勢已開始明顯擴散至人工智慧 (AI) 交易以外。美國經濟展現韌性，加上 AI 帶動廣泛生產力提升的預期，也讓更多類股受惠。
Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Mark Hackett 說：「市場廣度擴大的其中一項證據，就是價值股跑贏成長股，因為價值股涵蓋的個股更多元、分布也更廣。」他指出，價值股並非單押一項交易，而是涵蓋金融股、其他景氣循環股、防禦型股票及債券替代股。
Hackett 認為，這種情況與其說是股市潛在問題，反而對多頭行情是正面訊號。
過去價值股勝出有著直觀的邏輯： 股市下跌時，投資人通常會撤出成長股，尤其是估值高度依賴未來獲利預期的科技股。一旦利率飆升或市場情緒轉差，這類股票往往首當其衝。
相較之下，投資人通常偏好價值股，大多是必需消費品、公用事業及醫療保健等傳統防禦型產業。這些企業通常獲利較穩定、現金流可預測且估值較低，因此市場走弱時具有較強的下檔保護，同時通常也提供較高股息率，對尋求穩定收益的投資人更具吸引力。
但這次情況不同，股市即將進入多頭行情第四年，AI 仍是推動漲勢的主要引擎，大型 AI 基礎建設帶來的資本支出也處於歷史高檔。美國經濟雖然成長步伐較為放緩，但仍持續擴張，消費者支出也展現韌性。
對習慣看到價值股與成長股明顯分野的投資人而言，富時羅素 (FTSE Russell) 如今將許多大型科技股視為同時具備價值與成長特徵，也反映價值因子的定義正在改變。分析師指出，目前價值因子更看重獲利品質。
富時羅素美國指數產品管理主管 Catherine Yoshimoto 表示，羅素 1000 指數約 35% 的市值純粹屬於成長股，約 35% 純粹屬於價值股，另有約 30% 無法明確歸類，因此這些公司的股票會依其風格機率分配至不同指數。
富時羅素並非將公司硬性歸入單一類別，而是根據股價淨值比、未來兩年預估獲利成長及過去五年營收成長等指標計算風格機率，再按比例將股票市值分配至成長股與價值股指數。這也讓大型科技股能同時出現在兩類指數中。
因此，當前市場並不是成長股崩跌、價值股獨漲，而是在成長股仍維持雙位數報酬的同時，價值股漲勢更為強勁。
此外，隨著 AI 交易逐漸成熟，投資人的目光也從早期 AI 龍頭擴大至半導體及其他 AI 支出的第二、第三階段受惠者。富時羅素全球投資研究主管 Indrani De 指出，這些企業規模較小、更偏向價值股，估值也更具吸引力。
相較 2010 年代的超低利率環境，目前利率也更接近歷史正常水準，這同樣有利於價值股持續受到投資人青睞。
De 說：「我們都已習慣金融危機後成長股持續領先價值股的世界。但要記住，那是一個利率極低的世界。」她指出，目前市場正進入類似金融危機前的正常化利率環境，殖利率曲線也呈現向上傾斜，這是明顯有利價值股勝過成長股的環境。
第 2 季企業財報季已近尾聲，到目前為止科技股獲利表現非常強勁，但這也意味著明年將面臨較高的比較基期，尤其是隸屬「科技七巨頭」的那些大型科技股。相較之下，醫療保健及金融等價值型產業 2027 年第 2 季面臨的獲利比較基期較低，反而有機會持續取得相對優勢。
這使 Hackett 認為，價值股可能維持強勢表現，不只是「幾季行情」。
paras_en: Historically, whenever value stocks have shone, it usually meant the broader market was in a crash, but this time the situation is different: as the current bull market approaches its fourth year and major indices continue to oscillate near historic highs, the Russell 1000 Value Index (RLV) has vastly outperformed the Russell 1000 Growth Index (RLG).

According to data compiled by Nationwide, over the past year the Russell 1000 Value Index rose 31.6% while the Growth Index gained 13.5%. Calculated on a 12‑month relative return basis, the performance gap between the two widened to its largest since the 2022 bear market, reaching about 22% as of last week.

However, today’s leading value stocks are very different from traditional value representatives such as Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) and Comcast (CMCSA‑US). The Russell Value Index has been strong this year, partly because many of its holdings are technology stocks that were previously classified as growth stocks.
Amazon (AMZN‑US) is now the largest component of the Russell Value Index, followed by Apple (AAPL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US), which are also major holdings in the Russell Growth Index.

Early this year the strong performance of value stocks was helped in part by hot chip makers like Micron Technology (MU‑US) being added to the index. In June, however, Micron was removed in the latest rebalancing, just as the semiconductor rally peaked, allowing value investors to avoid a hit.

This does not change the fact that value stocks usually gain a relative edge when growth stocks lag. The last time the Russell Value Index delivered such a strong excess return before 2022 was during the peak of the dot‑com bubble.

Value stocks kept rising in August, indicating that the market rally is now spreading well beyond AI‑driven trading. A resilient U.S. economy combined with expectations that AI will boost productivity across the board is benefiting a broader set of sectors.

Nationwide chief market strategist Mark Hackett said, “One sign of expanding market breadth is value outpacing growth, because value covers a more diverse and wider range of stocks.” He noted that value is not a single bet but includes financials, other cyclical stocks, defensive equities and bond‑proxy stocks.
Hackett believes this situation is less a market flaw and more a positive signal for the ongoing bull market.

The logic behind value’s past outperformance is straightforward: when markets fall, investors typically pull out of growth stocks, especially tech stocks whose valuations rely heavily on future earnings expectations. A spike in rates or a shift in sentiment hits those stocks first.

By contrast, investors tend to favor value stocks, which are often consumer staples, utilities and healthcare—traditional defensive industries. These companies usually have steadier earnings, predictable cash flow and lower valuations, providing stronger downside protection in weak markets and often higher dividend yields that appeal to income‑seeking investors.

But this time is different: the market is entering the fourth year of a bull run, AI remains the main engine of the rally, and capital spending on large‑scale AI infrastructure is at historic highs. Although U.S. growth has slowed, the economy is still expanding and consumer spending remains resilient.

For investors accustomed to a clear split between value and growth, FTSE Russell now classifies many large tech stocks as having both value and growth characteristics, reflecting a shift in how the value factor is defined. Analysts say the value factor now places more emphasis on profit quality.

Catherine Yoshimoto, head of U.S. index product management at FTSE Russell, said roughly 35% of the Russell 1000’s market cap is pure growth, about 35% is pure value, and the remaining ~30% cannot be clearly classified, so those stocks are probabilistically allocated across the two indices.

FTSE Russell does not force a company into a single bucket; instead it calculates style probabilities based on price‑to‑book, projected earnings growth over the next two years and revenue growth over the past five years, then assigns market cap to growth and value indices proportionally. This allows large tech stocks to appear in both indices.

Thus, the current market is not a scenario of growth stocks crashing while value climbs alone; growth stocks are still delivering double‑digit returns, but value stocks are advancing even more strongly.

Moreover, as AI trading matures, investors’ focus is expanding from early AI leaders to second‑ and third‑stage beneficiaries in semiconductors and other AI‑related spend. FTSE Russell global investment research head Indrani De notes that these smaller, more value‑oriented companies have more attractive valuations.
Compared with the ultra‑low‑rate environment of the 2010s, today’s rates are closer to historic normals, which also benefits value stocks that continue to attract investor interest.

De said, “We’ve become accustomed to a post‑financial‑crisis world where growth outperforms value. But remember, that was a world of extremely low rates.” She added that the market is now moving into a normal‑rate environment similar to pre‑crisis levels, with an upward‑sloping yield curve, which clearly favors value over growth.

The second‑quarter earnings season is winding down, and so far tech earnings have been very strong, but that also means a higher comparative base for next year, especially for the mega‑cap “big‑seven” tech stocks. By contrast, value‑oriented sectors such as healthcare and finance face a lower profit base in Q2 2027, giving them a chance to maintain a relative edge.
Hackett concludes that value stocks may stay strong, not just for a few quarters, but for an extended period.

items.title: 紐約Fed調查：美國7月消費者就業信心改善 短期通膨預期降至3.6%
items.title_en: NY Fed Survey: US Consumer Job Confidence Improves in July, Short-Term Inflation Expectations Fall to 3.6%
paras: 紐約聯準銀行周五 (7 日) 公布的 7 月消費者預期調查顯示，美國民眾對重新找到工作的信心升高，短期通膨預期則小幅下降。不過，受訪者同時認為未來失業率可能上升，對自身失業與債務違約的憂慮也有所加深，反映消費者對經濟前景仍抱持矛盾態度。
調查顯示，受訪者認為失業後能找到新工作的平均機率升至 46.2%，創今年最高，增幅以高中以下學歷及家庭年收入低於 5 萬美元的族群最為明顯。主動離職的預期機率也有所上升。
然而，消費者預估未來一年失業率將升高的機率同步攀升，且各年齡與收入族群均出現類似變化。受訪者認為未來一年失去工作的可能性也略微增加，但仍低於過去 12 個月平均。
美國政府稍早公布，7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，勞動參與率持續下滑，失業率則降至 4.1%。疲弱的就業市場，加上近期油價回落，可能讓聯準會 (Fed) 有更多時間評估後續利率路徑。Fed 上周連續第五次維持利率不變，惟有三名官員主張升息 1 碼。
通膨方面，消費者對未來一年的通膨預期由 6 月的 3.7% 降至 3.6%，三年期與五年期預期則分別維持在 3.3% 及 3%。一年後汽油價格預期再度上升，房價漲幅預期則維持 3.2%。儘管中東戰事造成能源價格波動，民眾的中長期通膨看法並未明顯惡化，但仍高於 Fed 的 2% 目標。
家庭對自身財務狀況的評價有所改善，更多受訪者表示目前財務情況優於一年前，並預期 2027 年大致維持不變。民眾認為目前信貸更加難以取得，但未來取得信用的難度可能下降。
值得注意的是，未來三個月無法支付最低債務還款額的平均機率上升，尤其集中於年收入低於 5 萬美元的家庭。另一方面，消費者對股市更加樂觀，預期一年後股價上漲的機率升至 2021 年 4 月調查開始以來最高。
paras_en: The New York Fed's consumer expectations survey, released on Friday (July 7), showed that Americans' confidence in finding new jobs has improved, while short-term inflation expectations have declined slightly. However, respondents also believe that the unemployment rate may rise in the future, and their concerns about personal unemployment and debt default have increased, reflecting a mixed outlook on the economy.

The survey found that respondents believe the average probability of finding a new job after losing their current one has risen to 46.2%, a record high this year, with the greatest increase seen among those with a high school education or less and household incomes below $50,000. The probability of actively quitting their jobs has also increased.

However, the probability of respondents estimating that the unemployment rate will rise in the next year has also increased, with similar changes observed across all age and income groups. Respondents also believe that the likelihood of losing their jobs in the next year has increased slightly, but remains lower than the average over the past 12 months.

The US government earlier reported that non-farm employment unexpectedly fell by 23,000 in July, with labor participation rates continuing to decline and the unemployment rate falling to 4.1%. The weak labor market, combined with recent declines in oil prices, may give the Federal Reserve (Fed) more time to evaluate its future interest rate path. The Fed maintained its interest rate unchanged for the fifth consecutive week, with only three officials advocating for a 1% rate hike.

On the inflation front, consumer expectations for inflation over the next year fell to 3.6% from 3.7% in June, while three-year and five-year expectations remained at 3.3% and 3%, respectively. Gasoline prices are expected to rise again in the next year, while housing price growth expectations remain at 3.2%. Despite the volatility in energy prices due to the Middle East conflict, consumers' medium-term inflation views have not worsened significantly, but remain above the Fed's 2% target.

Households have a more positive assessment of their financial situation, with more respondents saying they are better off financially than a year ago, and expecting their financial situation to remain largely unchanged in 2027. Consumers believe that credit has become more difficult to obtain, but that the difficulty of obtaining credit may decline in the future.

Notably, the average probability of being unable to pay the minimum debt repayment amount over the next three months has increased, particularly among households with incomes below $50,000. On the other hand, consumers have become more optimistic about the stock market, with the probability of stock prices rising in the next year increasing to a record high since the survey began in April 2021.

items.title: SK海力士調整中國布局？30億美元重慶廠傳尋找投資人
items.title_en: SK Hynix Adjusting Its China Footprint? $3 Billion Chongqing Plant Said to Be Seeking Investors
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 據傳正評估中國重慶廠的多項處置方案，包括引進投資人以加速業務成長。知情人士透露，若公司最終決定出售部分股權，這座廠區的估值可能達到約 30 億美元。
《彭博》周五 (7 日) 報導，SK 海力士目前正與潛在顧問接洽，準備對重慶業務展開評估。可能的買家包括中國基金及產業業者，公司則可能保留該資產的少數股權。不過，相關討論仍處於初步階段，不一定會促成任何交易。SK 海力士代表拒絕置評。
SK 海力士是輝達 (Nvidia) 高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 的主要供應商之一，進入中國市場已有逾 20 年。公司當年與中國江蘇省無錫市簽署協議，設立首座大型海外晶圓製造廠；重慶廠則是其大規模半導體封裝與測試基地，協助公司擴大全球 NAND 快閃記憶體後段製程產能。
在評估引資重慶廠的同時，SK 海力士也持續擴大南韓本土投資。公司周五宣布，計劃投入 54 兆韓元 (約 380 億美元) 擴充晶片製造設施，包括在龍仁興建新的 DRAM 生產設施，並於清州打造 NAND 晶圓廠。
SK 海力士表示，這項投資是為了因應人工智慧 (AI) 時代日益成長的記憶體需求。相關布局顯示，公司可能一面重新調整中國後段製程資產的持股結構，一面將大筆資本支出集中於南韓先進記憶體產能，但目前尚無跡象顯示重慶廠評估案已作出最終決定。
paras_en: South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US) is reportedly evaluating several options for its Chongqing plant in China, including bringing in investors to accelerate business growth. Sources say that if the company ultimately decides to sell a portion of its equity, the site could be valued at roughly $3 billion.

Bloomberg reported on Friday (the 7th) that SK Hynix is in talks with potential advisors as it prepares to assess the Chongqing operation. Possible buyers could include Chinese funds and industry players, while the company may retain a minority stake in the asset. However, the discussions are still in early stages and may not lead to any transaction. An SK Hynix spokesperson declined to comment.

SK Hynix is one of Nvidia’s main suppliers of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and has been in the Chinese market for more than 20 years. The company signed an agreement that year with Wuxi in Jiangsu Province to set up its first large overseas wafer fab; the Chongqing plant serves as a major semiconductor packaging and testing hub, helping the company expand its global NAND flash back‑end capacity.

While evaluating capital infusion for the Chongqing plant, SK Hynix continues to expand its domestic investments in South Korea. On Friday the company announced plans to invest 54 trillion won (about $38 billion) to expand chip‑making facilities, including a new DRAM production line in Yongin and a NAND wafer fab in Cheongju.

SK Hynix said the investment is aimed at meeting the growing memory demand of the artificial‑intelligence (AI) era. The overall strategy suggests the company may be reshaping its ownership structure in China’s back‑end assets while concentrating large capital expenditures on advanced memory capacity in South Korea, though there is no sign yet that a final decision on the Chongqing plant has been made.

items.title: Fed還升得下去嗎？華爾街看完非農都說先等等 升息恐扼殺製造業復甦
items.title_en: Can the Fed Keep Raising Rates? Wall Street Says Wait After the Jobs Report, Rate Hikes Could Stifle Manufacturing Recovery
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅也由 5.7 萬人大幅下修至 2 萬人，使市場開始質疑聯準會 (Fed) 是否仍有條件在 9 月升息。不過，華爾街分析師普遍認為，一個月的疲弱數據還不足以證明就業市場已陷入衰退，但足以讓 Fed 重新權衡升息對就業的傷害，9 月按兵不動的可能性明顯升高。
美國 7 月失業率由 4.2% 降至 4.1%，主要受到勞動參與率持續下滑影響。Fed 上周以 9 票對 3 票決定將利率維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，三名異議官員則主張升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。就業報告公布後，期貨市場預估 Fed 9 月升息機率由 55% 降至 40%。

升息恐先傷製造業「治療可能比疾病更糟」

Annex Wealth Management 首席經濟學家 Brian Jacobsen 指出，Fed 接下來必須格外謹慎，因為升息通常最先、也最嚴重地衝擊製造業。如今製造業就業才剛浮現復甦跡象，若為了壓抑通膨而收緊政策，可能反而扼殺這波萌芽中的改善。
Jacobsen 認為，目前服務業通膨已逐步降溫，商品價格上漲主要由關稅與能源成本推動，並非貨幣政策過度寬鬆所致。在這種情況下，升息未必能有效處理通膨根源，付出的經濟代價反而可能超過成效，尤其 7 月就業疲弱可能帶有季節性，而非結構性惡化。
他預估，面對結構性通膨問題，Fed 主席華許可能更傾向優先縮減資產負債表，而不是透過升息壓低需求。如果 9 月仍有太多決策官員要求升息，華許甚至可能投下反對票。

單月數據不是趨勢 但足以讓 Fed 暫停升息

Ameriprise Financial 首席市場策略師 Anthony Saglimbene 表示，即使 7 月非農就業出現負值，美國勞動市場整體仍算健康，因此不宜過度解讀單月數據，「一個數字並不構成趨勢」。不過，這份報告確實為 Fed 在 9 月暫停升息提供更多空間。
Saglimbene 指出，Fed 近期政策討論明顯偏重控制通膨，但疲弱的就業數據可能重新調整討論方向，讓決策官員更加重視充分就業這一側的法定任務。若未來升息可能進一步壓抑企業聘僱，Fed 就有理由先觀察政策影響。他預期，Fed 最終不會在 9 月升息。
高盛資產管理多元固定收益投資主管 Lindsay Rosner 也傾向 Fed 按兵不動。她表示，歷史不會完全重演，但有時會呈現相似節奏；這已是連續第三年出現 7 月就業成長在盛夏失去動能的情況，顯示季節性因素可能放大數據疲弱程度。
Rosner 強調，接下來的通膨數據仍將是 Fed 是否升息的最終裁決者，但就業成長放緩已為 9 月維持利率不變提供支持。換言之，華爾街並未因非農轉負而立即判定經濟衰退，卻普遍認為，在通膨成因未必能靠升息解決、就業風險逐漸浮現之際，Fed 沒有必要急於進一步緊縮。
paras_en: U.S. nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell by 23,000 in July, and the June gain was sharply revised down from 57,000 to 20,000, prompting the market to question whether the Federal Reserve still has room to raise rates in September. Still, most Wall Street analysts think a single month of weak data isn’t enough to prove the labor market is in a recession, but it is enough for the Fed to reassess the damage rate hikes could do to employment, making a pause in September much more likely.

The U.S. unemployment rate slipped from 4.2% to 4.1% in July, mainly due to a continued decline in the labor‑force participation rate. The Fed voted last week 9‑to‑3 to keep the target range at 3.50%‑3.75%, with three dissenting members urging a 25‑basis‑point hike. After the jobs report, futures markets trimmed the probability of a September hike from 55% to 40%.

Rate hikes could first hurt manufacturing, “the cure may be worse than the disease.” Brian Jacobsen, chief economist at Annex Wealth Management, warned that the Fed must be especially cautious because rate increases tend to hit the manufacturing sector first and hardest. Manufacturing employment is only just beginning to show signs of recovery, and tightening policy to curb inflation could instead choke this nascent improvement.

Jacobsen said that services‑sector inflation is already cooling, and the rise in commodity prices is driven mainly by tariffs and energy costs, not by an overly loose monetary stance. In this context, raising rates may not effectively address the root causes of inflation, and the economic cost could outweigh the benefits, especially since July’s weak jobs numbers may be seasonal rather than a sign of structural deterioration.

He estimates that, faced with structural inflation, Fed Chair Jerome Powell may prefer to focus on balance‑sheet reduction rather than using rate hikes to dampen demand. If enough policymakers still push for a hike in September, Powell could even cast a dissenting vote.

A single month’s data does not define a trend, but it is enough to give the Fed pause. Anthony Saglimbene, chief market strategist at Ameriprise Financial, said that even though July’s nonfarm payrolls were negative, the overall U.S. labor market remains healthy, so the figure should not be over‑interpreted; “one number does not make a trend.” Nonetheless, the report does give the Fed more leeway to hold rates steady in September.

Saglimbene noted that recent Fed discussions have focused heavily on inflation control, but the weak jobs data could shift the conversation toward the statutory mandate of full employment. If future hikes risk further suppressing hiring, the Fed would have reason to observe the policy impact first. He expects the Fed ultimately will not raise rates in September.

Lindsay Rosner, head of multi‑asset fixed‑income investing at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, also leans toward a Fed pause. She said history does not repeat exactly, but sometimes follows similar rhythms; this is the third consecutive year that July employment growth loses momentum in midsummer, suggesting seasonal factors may amplify the weakness in the data.

Rosner emphasized that upcoming inflation readings will remain the ultimate arbiter of any rate move, but the slowdown in job growth already supports keeping rates unchanged in September. In other words, Wall Street is not declaring a recession simply because the jobs report turned negative; rather, most see that with inflation’s drivers unlikely to be solved by rate hikes and employment risks emerging, the Fed has no urgent need to tighten further.
